sloka: सर्वथा धर्म इति एव द्रष्टव्यः तव निग्रहः ।वयस्यस्य उपकर्तव्यम् धर्मम् एव अनुपश्यता ॥४-१८-२९॥
transliteration: sarvathā dharma iti eva draṣṭavyaḥ tava nigrahaḥ ।vayasyasya upakartavyam dharmam eva anupaśyatā ॥4-18-29॥

translations.english: 'Punishment given to you should be viewed as a right course of action in all respects. This is the duty of a trustworthy friend who follows dharma.
